Inter-group gap = 0.06 × fitted scene width. Settings within the navigation group use half that gap. Measure from the visible player top to LED bottom, excluding the hidden tabletop’s empty area.

The scene has a 1140px design maximum and a width/height budget. Player width = 52% of scene; side discs = 22%. The old scene box is 2:1, while the table-free visible slot is measured from the rendered player and LED.

At ≥1800px wide AND ≥900px tall, home uses 1.25 composition scale. All typography and controls scale together; the player still fits available height. This is not a promise of exactly 25% larger artwork when the viewport constrains it.

1920 × 1080: 54.59px above and below player, matching 55px settings controls. 1440 × 960: 46.92px above and 46.91px below. 390 × 844: no horizontal overflow. Values are observations, not hardcoded gaps.
A small display, attached to the object.
The record player is the sole play/pause surface. The LED communicates state; the surrounding circular buttons skip tracks.

Width = 31.2% of scene = 60% of the player’s width. Base height = clamp(32px, 9.5% of scene width, 44px). Radius 6px. Padding: 3px top/bottom, 7px left, 24px right. Center at 50% of scene width; overlap the front edge.

Previous on left; next on right. Visual diameter = min(9.5% of scene width, 44px), gap to LED = min(1.73% of scene width, 8px). Each invisible hit target stays 44 × 44px at base scale. Icon = min(4.32% of scene width, 20px).

Empty hover label: “load and play.” No autoplay on arrival. Skip while playing continues playback; skip while paused remains paused. Records move from left to platter to right one at a time. The LED has no progress bar.

The LED’s 32px height floor and 16px text floor take priority over exact visual scaling at narrow widths. Titles scroll inside the display. Floating controls remain independently reachable; decorative stacks are not competing play controls.

Apple’s guidelines describe native platforms in points. This portfolio is a website measured in CSS pixels; these units are not a universal physical equivalence.

Apple’s current HIG table recommends 44 × 44pt controls on iOS/iPadOS and lists a 28 × 28pt minimum; its UI design tips emphasize 44 × 44pt. This site adopts a conservative 44 × 44 CSS px touch-target goal. Decorative artwork can be smaller than the target.

Apple lists iOS/iPadOS default text at 17pt and minimum 11pt; macOS differs. These are platform-specific, not a reason to shrink website text. The portfolio uses at least 16 CSS px and allows larger headings. Apple does not give one universal maximum.

Support larger text, sufficient contrast, spacing between targets and reduced motion. Do not force readable content into one screen by shrinking it. Preserve image proportions. Use crisp vector identity assets.

Current verification covers selected viewport geometry, overflow and controls. Full keyboard, screen-reader, 200% text enlargement, contrast in all themes, and touch-target overlap audits remain to be completed. The inspector flags candidates for review; it is not an accessibility certification.
